sonnet.problem: The joke 'In WRITING, friend, and all I ever got in the drawer was old takeout menus' makes no sense to a stranger, because the setup ('compliment' to 'in WRITING') never connects to it. It also mentions 'the drawer' without saying what drawer it is (his junk drawer), though bakers may not know his backstory.
sonnet.rule: If a stranger would say "huh?", rewrite it. ... Anything from his backstory, like the drawer, the Millers, the shiny new stamper or the angel, is said in the line itself

sonnet.problem: The question of card 4 puts 'Christ' in front of the baker ('the head of Christ'). Card 5, which comes right after, then has 'Christ' as its right answer for the head of every man, so card 4 hands over card 5's answer.
sonnet.rule: No card ever gives away the answer to a choice card that comes later.

sonnet.problem: The card says Paul 'reaches all the way back to creation, to the very first man and woman.' Verses 7-8 don't say creation or 'the very first' man and woman. The text only says woman came from man, and creation first appears in v9. This adds a setting and a link the text leaves open.
sonnet.rule: Leave open what the text leaves open. Who is being spoken to, why, or how two things connect. ... No added settings. No setting the text doesn't give.
